request.script: Every morning, an old gardener walked to the edge of the village with a small watering can. He had planted a single seed in a quiet corner of the field. For weeks nothing happened, and the neighbours laughed. But he kept watering the soil, day after day. One spring morning, a tiny green shoot pushed through the earth. Years later, children played in the shade of a tall tree. Patience, he said, is how great things grow.
